bio.id: Saya kuliah Sistem Informasi di [nama kampus]. Paling sering saya bikin website dan aplikasi kecil, belakangan juga mulai belajar mengolah data. Kalau lagi nggak di depan laptop, biasanya saya keluar bawa kamera.
bio.en: I study Information Systems at [campus name]. Most of what I make is websites and small apps, and lately I’ve started learning to work with data. When I’m not at my laptop, I’m usually out with a camera.
